name: Starter: A Simple Log
subtitle: Write it down, find it later
promo: A plain log for anything you want to keep track of. Everything stays on your phone.
description:
Starter is the example every new app in this collection begins from. It keeps a list of entries, each with a title, an amount and a date, and shows the total at the top.

Add an entry in two taps. Open one to change it or remove it. Everything is kept on your phone: there is no account, nothing is sent anywhere, and it works with no connection.

This text is here to show the shape a description takes: what the app does in the first sentence, how it is used in the second paragraph, and what it does not do with your data at the end.
reviewNotes: The app works without an account or a connection. Open it and tap + to add an entry.
